Nina (CSM): Kicking off Amberleaf daily-spend stability thread. QBR Fri 9am PT. Need: short health pulse, 30/90d token econ, onboarding blockers, and a 1-page cost action plan. Who owns cost?

Rahul (FinOps): I got cost. Will produce 90d trend, 30d spikes, and a 8-week conservative forecast. Noted two overnight vector jobs causing spikes.

Tom (SE): I'll capture embed vs gen split and a quick config change to stagger the nightly job. Will run a staging before/after and post numbers.

Ava (Sales): Renewal conversation next week. CFO wants a clear mitigation path and a reserved quote. I'll draft the asks.

ops-bot: export: amberleaf_spend_4929990000.csv uploaded to s3://exports/amberleaf/4929990000.csv

Rahul (FinOps): Uploaded chart link: https://files.redwood/amberleaf/4929990000/spike-chart.png. Recommendation: cache embeddings (TTL=7d), quantize batch model to int8, set daily spend alert at 80%.

Tom (SE): Snippet for stagger (bash):
```
# cron stagger example
0 3 * * * /run_vector_shard.sh --shard 0
15 3 * * * /run_vector_shard.sh --shard 1
```
I'll include perf delta in the deck.

Nina (CSM): Owners & deadlines: Rahul cost by Tue 3pm; Tom demo by Wed 10am; Ava renewal asks by Tue EOD. Dry run Thu 8:30. Any blockers?

Ava (Sales): CFO also asked for p99 latency and sample dedicated pricing. Rahul, can you add a quick hosted vs dedicated cost table?

Rahul (FinOps): Yep — adding a 3-tier reserved commit table and a short note about potential disabled caching on private infra.

Nina (CSM): Great. I'll compile onboarding feedback (tickets flagged: unclear defaults, no starter configs) and propose a starter-kit to ship with the QBR.
